scope: versioned multimodal business output contracts -> generation prompt -> deterministic structure audit

design_basis.adopted_mechanism: S5 Playbook must declare input, output, evidence scope, side effects, and confirmation points; missing evidence must remain explicit.
Keep document-grounded evidence and inspectable retrieval/generation stages separate from the business result format.
Keep task policy and confirmation boundaries explicit and outside untrusted model content.

implemented: paper_review, experiment_compare, and meeting_actions each declare a versioned response_contract with required sections, evidence rules, and the missing-evidence marker.
The workflow plan and UI expose the required output structure before execution, so users can see what the selected business task will produce.
The generation system prompt receives the contract only after workflow selection; the retrieval query remains unchanged to avoid adding format terms to recall and evidence matching.
Completed workflow answers are checked with a bounded deterministic section audit and the result is recorded in rag.completed; the audit does not judge factual truth or citation validity.
regressions: The three workflow catalogs expose non-empty response contracts and plan_workflow returns the selected contract.
Numbered headings and colon-prefixed headings are recognized; missing sections are reported without modifying the answer.
The generation prompt contains the experiment comparison contract while the user/retrieval message does not receive the contract text.
claims_not_supported: No claim is made that a prompt contract alone improves answer accuracy, citation correctness, or multimodal benchmark scores.
The structure audit is not a factuality or NLI evaluator and does not replace claim-to-citation validation.
Real 30-episode evaluation, multimodal-vs-text-only gain, complete-chain P50/P95 under 5 seconds, and sealed-test validation remain incomplete.
